2311e87c Mistral Blanc was delivered in Livorno and fully refreshed in 2024: white lacquer, pale ash, ivory leather and touches of soft gold. Everything aboard is filled with light, right up to the grand saloon on the main deck.

5a5fa22a Based in Monaco, she happily heads for Portofino or Corsica. Her chef spent ten years in Michelin‑starred houses on the Riviera; the table is laid on the aft deck, facing the harbour as it lights up.

b74c41e9 Solenne is a sailing yacht you can handle with six aboard, effortlessly, thanks to the furling systems designed by her yard. The teak cockpit shelters under a bimini, and the wheel is shared with anyone who wants to learn.
23149738 Below deck, varnished teak, cream canvas and forest‑green leather recall the great sailing yachts of old. Porquerolles, Port‑Cros and the Levant are half a day's sail from Saint‑Tropez.

14a2172e Tramontane is the liveliest of the fleet: she runs from Saint‑Tropez to Cannes in an hour, leaving time for lunch at the Lérins islands before heading home. Her grey hull and tinted glazing give her a sporting look.

6f8ed497 On board, grey eucalyptus, black leather and brushed steel make for a disciplined, almost architectural interior. The flybridge, sheltered by a hardtop, becomes the main lounge as soon as the sun is high.
